corq_box.title: CorQ
corq_box.text: CorQ is the final win probability for the displayed pick. It can use ThinQ data now and may later include MarQ market input.
corq_box.short: Final win probability for the displayed pick.

thinq_box.title: ThinQ
thinq_box.text: ThinQ shows the overall data quality behind the match analysis. It is not win probability. Higher values mean stronger data coverage and more reliable inputs.
thinq_box.short: Overall data quality behind the match analysis.

pick_data_depth.title: Pick Data Depth
pick_data_depth.text: Pick Data Depth shows how strongly the available ThinQ data supports the displayed pick. It combines data quality with the strength and direction of the ThinQ edge.
pick_data_depth.short: How strongly ThinQ data supports this pick.

form_data_depth.title: Form Data Depth
form_data_depth.text: Form Data Depth shows how reliable the Recent Form, Surface Form and Opponent Quality data are.

elo_selo.title: ELO / S-ELO
elo_selo.text: ELO shows overall player strength. S-ELO shows strength on the current surface. Positive values support the pick. Negative values go against the pick.
elo_selo.short: Overall ELO and surface ELO edge for the pick.

h2h.title: H2H
h2h.text: H2H means head-to-head history between the pick and the opponent. Example: 1W-0L means the pick won 1 previous match and lost 0 against this opponent.
h2h.short: Head-to-head history between the two players.

s_h2h.title: S-H2H
s_h2h.text: S-H2H means head-to-head history between the two players only on the current surface. If no surface match exists, it is shown as No data.
s_h2h.short: Head-to-head history on the current surface.

thinq_edge.title: ThinQ Edge
thinq_edge.text: ThinQ Edge is the combined data edge from ThinQ layers. Positive values support the displayed pick. Negative values go against the displayed pick.
thinq_edge.short: Combined ThinQ data edge for the pick.

pick_form_sform.title: Pick Form / S-Form
pick_form_sform.text: Pick Form is the pick's recent overall win-loss record. S-Form is the pick's recent win-loss record on the current surface. Example: 7W-3L / 6W-4L.
pick_form_sform.short: Pick recent form and surface form.

opp_form_sform.title: Opp Form / S-Form
opp_form_sform.text: Opp Form is the opponent's recent overall win-loss record. S-Form is the opponent's recent win-loss record on the current surface.
opp_form_sform.short: Opponent recent form and surface form.

recent_edge.title: Pick R-Edge
recent_edge.text: Pick R-Edge is the recent form edge from the pick's perspective. Positive values support the pick. Negative values go against the pick.
recent_edge.short: Recent form edge for the pick.

surface_edge.title: Pick S-Edge
surface_edge.text: Pick S-Edge is the surface recent form edge from the pick's perspective. Positive values support the pick. Negative values go against the pick.
surface_edge.short: Surface form edge for the pick.

form_quality.title: Pick Form Qty
form_quality.text: Pick Form Qty estimates whether the pick's recent form was built against stronger or weaker opponents. Positive values support the pick. Negative values go against the pick.
form_quality.short: Opponent quality adjustment for recent form.

sets_games.title: Sets / Games
sets_games.text: Sets / Games are ThinQ match dynamics estimates. They show projected sets, projected games, three-set probability, likely score and tie-break probability.

marq_box.title: MarQ
marq_box.text: MarQ is the market view layer. It is planned as a market-quality and market-movement layer and is not fully active yet.
marq_box.short: Market view layer, planned for later.
